name: Virginity Before Marriage
overview: Scripture upholds virginity before marriage as a vital aspect of honoring God's design for purity and covenantal unity, as seen in Genesis 2:24 where a man and wife become one flesh. The law in Exodus 22:16 and Deuteronomy 22:20 emphasizes the seriousness of sexual relations outside the marriage bond, underscoring the expectation of chastity before betrothal. Jesus' teaching in Matthew 5:28 reveals that purity extends beyond physical actions to the heart, warning against lustful intent. Furthermore, Romans 1:24 and 12:1 call believers to live holy lives by offering their bodies as living sacrifices, reflecting God's call to holiness in all areas, including sexual purity.
